description: A one-bedroom on the west corner facing the mountains: pale plaster, warm oak, a platform bed under the long window. A galley kitchen, a soaking tub, a window seat built for watching the storms roll in from somewhere safe and dry. The door seals with a soft magnetic sigh. Leave east to the landing.

window.description: A tall pane runs floor to ceiling down one wall, black-framed, holding the city out there like something in a case.
window.name: the window

name: Solenne Residence 8-C
